observation: Fresh main constructs authority receipt ids only as auth-<base36 timestamp>-<10 lowercase hex>, but the durable _record boundary accepts any string beginning auth-. Because receipt ids are interpolated into a filesystem path, forged separator/dot-segment ids can leave the store-owned filename shape and can traverse outside the authority-receipts directory before this change.
changes: Constrain authority receipt ids at the durable boundary to the existing writer-owned auth-<base36>-<10 lower hex> shape before path construction.
Publish the same id shape in the v0.1 contract and align focused timestamp/digest fixtures with real writer-compatible ids.

truth_boundary: This hardens the receipt store path/identity boundary using the existing writer format. It does not add cross-receipt uniqueness, external identity attestation, signing, or trust-root semantics.
